purpose_context: Felix's WhatsApp DM reply delivery has been silently broken since the recent agent-extraction work, leaving cron-driven announce-mode outbound (morning checkin, IDLE pings, digests) as the only working WhatsApp surface. Inbound DMs are received and processed end-to-end, but the gateway never bridges the agent's reply output to the channel-send subsystem on DM-initiated turns. The fix restores conversational interaction, the primary daily interface for Kent to query and direct Felix via mobile.
purpose_tldr: Fix Felix's WhatsApp DM-reply path so inbound DMs receive a delivered reply, restoring the primary conversational interface.
source_description: GitHub issue #588 — WhatsApp DM reply delivery silently fails; main/subagent generate replies but channel never sends
